purpose: Pin the post-clipping source boundary, stale-cache lineage and independent pseudoinverse rank domain before any new numerical claim.

input_boundary.required: The exact owned initial request and complete finite clipped/rebuilt source state, with the same image-prelude authority and full MT19937 stream.
input_boundary.convergence: Finite positive scalar; no tolerance enters native branch selection.
input_boundary.owned_caller: Derive all controls from the authenticated make_voronoi prelude. Its smoothing is None and fix_bounds is True.
input_boundary.manufactured_options: Separate kind cells.manufactured_native_mesh_lifecycle_options@1 and provenance. Only the five lifecycle parameters may change; absolute smoothing is bounded by 4 * cell_radius**2.
input_boundary.auxiliary_operators: Retain the source implementation needed by the lifecycle closure. Test direct auxiliary construction only on explicit manufactured topology; no new public auxiliary caller admission.

source_semantics: smoothing=None skips the smoothing branch. smoothing=0 still calls init_mesh, computes operators and a pseudoinverse, updates x then y, and rebuilds.
Each source pre_mesh leaves old operator arrays and inverses present until the source overwrites them. Preserve partial updates and stale inverses on failures.
Refinement computes norm(circumcentres-centres, axis=1)**2 without rewriting the norm or reduction.
Each iteration resets removed_bad_verts before comparing the exact native UU > convergence predicate.
fix_bounds=True copies only inner_voronoi_centres to their original point slots; False copies all slots. Point identities do not follow nearest coordinates.
Only the convergence branch stores mesh_qual. Max-step exhaustion and zero steps do not invent convergence or refresh stale mesh_qual.
The lifecycle rebuilds after refine_mesh even for zero steps or immediate convergence, then always rebuilds core operators.
Core incidence writes the target endpoint +1 before the source endpoint -1; a self-loop therefore ends at -1.
Auxiliary face incidence preserves roll direction, paired ordered cKDTree queries, exact zero predicates, raw tie decisions and source ordering.
All np.dot and np.linalg.pinv calls retain their source arguments and defaults. Hooks only capture inputs, outputs, partial locals and failures.

ownership_and_lineage.runtime: Replay the original prefix using a private full-state RNG, then require the exact clipped cache identity, retained IDs and RNG before continuing. This preserves source aliases and array layouts.
ownership_and_lineage.snapshots: Reuse immutable typed numeric, object and ragged cache snapshots, retaining dtypes, bytes, strides and source shape.
ownership_and_lineage.coordinate_ids: IDs remain attached to moving point slots. Subsequent exact native deletion indices remove those occurrences; no nearest-neighbour identity recovery or coordinate canonicalization.
ownership_and_lineage.tree_locals: Retain owned tree-input tokens rather than exporting live cKDTree objects.
ownership_and_lineage.random_stream: No new random draws are expected after clipping. Compare the complete MT19937 state, including position, cached Gaussian flag and value; preserve the module-global stream.

raw_evidence.before_expectations: Save actual State or rejected trial, full native typed cache and events, then independent reports before source-completion or numerical assertions. Save isolated-helper unexpected completions as well as expected failures.
raw_evidence.source_failures: Retain partial local matrices, public caches, operator presence, first failure origin, warnings, full RNG and point IDs. Do not clean up or substitute state.
raw_evidence.reference_failures: Retain partial independent reports, including Decimal values outside the float64 range.
raw_evidence.ancillary_checks: Cache-ownership and call-order checks also save their lifecycle trial before expectations.

independent_reference.implementation: Standard-library Decimal and Fraction only; Decimal precisions 100 and 160. No source SVD, NumPy, SciPy or production imports.
independent_reference.geometry_boundary: Rounded captured areas, lengths, centres, points and source topology are supplied inputs. This does not independently generate or qualify those quantities.
independent_reference.incidence: Construct endpoint entries and ordered face-edge signs independently from supplied topology. Duplicate directed matches remain unresolved diagnostics; no canonical tie-index claim.
independent_reference.graph_pseudoinverse: For bounded grounded incidence, construct the connected-component gauge projector P and solve (A.T*A + P)^(-1)*A.T using Decimal elimination. Handle transposed incidence independently.
independent_reference.graph_rank_separation: With n <=32 columns, an anchored path bound or mean-zero path bound gives nonzero sigma >=1/(n+1); sigma_max <=sqrt(2*maximum_degree). Require the resulting conservative relative gap to exceed 1000 times the pinned default rcond.
independent_reference.other_pseudoinverses: Use exact constant-matrix rank-zero/rank-one formulas or independently invert a bounded square full-rank matrix. Bound its relative singular gap by 1/sqrt(norm1(A)*normInf(A)*norm1(Ainv)*normInf(Ainv)).
independent_reference.cutoff: Pin NumPy 2.5.3 linalg/_linalg.py and its AST default branch rcond=1e-15 in the source map. The native oracle authenticates the loaded package source. Never silently override rcond.
independent_reference.rank_refusal: Unsupported or unresolved rank domains retain their report and fail a declared numerical check. No independent truncated-SVD result is claimed.
independent_reference.identities: Independently calculate all four Moore-Penrose identities on the captured rounded A and Aplus.
independent_reference.smoothing: Assemble the metric-weighted matrix from exact rational representations of the captured input floats, solve independently in the resolved rank domain, and compare the full resulting coordinates.
independent_reference.other_checks: Independent matrix/vector products, quality squared distances, normalized energy and exact refinement copies. Energy branch disagreements are diagnostics and do not change native selection.
independent_reference.dimensional_products: Retain term1 and LL products as diagnostics in m^-2 without inventing an absolute accuracy budget for them. Assert dimensionless term2 and coordinate products.

candidate_panel.coverage: Square and hex prefixes; core-only, zero refinement steps, early convergence and step exhaustion; zero/positive smoothing; inner/all-point refinement; connected/disconnected incidence; direct auxiliary operators; singular constant smoothing; raw nonfinite solve and out-of-range endpoint failures.
candidate_panel.observed_branch_credit: Only branches present in saved actual traces receive qualification credit. Manufactured helpers do not imply whole-mesh branch coverage.

proposed_tolerances.native: Exact full typed cache, layouts, events, point IDs and full RNG.
proposed_tolerances.failure_policy: Preserve and report failed fixtures and budgets. Do not shift fixtures, widen tolerances, change native primitives or relabel failures to pass.

upstream_initial_qualification.known_limits: Merged constructor input was refused upstream; square nearzero centroid and hex radius/inradius exceeded fixed numerical budgets. Saved-input diagnosis belongs to Root. No requalification here.

upstream_clipping_qualification: Root accepted clipping continuation after31 reused checks,21 native and21 independent records plus4 domain records. Old failure is preserved. This component takes no new upstream qualification credit.
excluded_claims: Independent topology generation, universal mesh validity or canonical ties
Physical cell surface/volume admission or biological geometry
Stable geometry arithmetic path or repaired native primitives
SVG/single-cell caller admission or public auxiliary-operator flag changes
Global convergence from bounded step exhaustion
qualification_preconditions: Chief reviews the exact39 IDs, frozen dependency closure, source/cache/RNG lineage and independent rank scope.
Chief accepts the guarded fresh-process replay and metadata finalization package; the numerical gate remains false during preparation.
Root schedules the detached qualification in its next round; no scientific imports, fixture generation, collection or numerical work occur in static preparation.

prepared_execution.launch_policy: Root launches detached with durable logs; no automatic polling, retry or follow-up audit.
prepared_execution.parent_imports: Standard library and mechanically extracted metadata/resource guard only.

bounded_evidence_processing.native: Hold actual and fresh proof; release actual before reading the saved native record. Save fresh raw output before expectations.
bounded_evidence_processing.reference: Reiterable saved-event view decodes one typed payload at a time. Saved reports are read one at a time; keep only the two independent refined reports needed for fixed budgets.
bounded_evidence_processing.finalization: Separate guarded process. Read one actual record at a time; retain only compact coverage rows. Stream file hashes and deduplicate runtime paths; never aggregate raw actual/native JSON.
bounded_evidence_processing.object_restore: Safe np.empty(object) with declared contiguous layouts; never interpret pointer bytes as object storage.
bounded_evidence_processing.failure: Stop numerical units on first failure. Only guarded partial evidence finalization follows; preserve partial raw output and guard stop receipts.

whole_job_resources_proposal.scope: Aggregate supervisor cap covers controller setup, workers and finalization; individual worker limits stay 1 GiB/480 s.
